result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends largely on where you operate, how many employees you have, and whether you want payroll integrated with your accounting software.

**My recommendation is to choose a platform that automates payroll calculations, tax and superannuation obligations, payslips, leave tracking and reporting** rather than simply one that offers the cheapest monthly subscription.

If you're operating in Australia, I'd shortlist these options\:

## Best payroll software in Australia

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero Payroll**

(Best overall for most small businesses)

- Payroll integrated with accounting.
- STP Phase 2 reporting.
- Payslips, leave and superannuation.
- Good accountant and bookkeeper integration.

Best if you already use Xero.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![Employment Hero - Which HR Software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hoOMaIHHE1BVK8wWyswfFUWF-4zNLm2VTTf8I0IsZi71QvwwVg013JN6PZd_JzmKlLo5GMH1Nn9Dlq8Awe3_MYWQTya_RX2YJlpU2kxq0LmTpktkVrYam4C6Jqjid1iaOedcQ7rhD-uZbRDBcKqCEBszhJOC_eRUB4bTTF7gnOKcGZ7dKIuzDzdg-ruuRgJy?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Employment Hero**

(Best for award-based employees)

- Modern Award interpretation.
- Timesheets and rostering.
- Payroll and HR management.
- Employee onboarding and leave.

Particularly useful for hospitality, retail and businesses with varying pay rates.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. MYOB**

(Best for standalone payroll)

- Payroll-only option for smaller teams.
- PAYG and super calculations.
- Payslips and STP reporting.
- Accountant and bookkeeper access.

Worth considering if you have four or fewer employees.

[MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au/)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Reckon Payroll**

(Best budget option)

- Straightforward payroll processing.
- STP reporting.
- Superannuation support.
- Suitable for very small teams.

[Reckon website](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

---

![Deputy Reviews & Ratings 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/qoByH159DzYjIg5JFSgJe_CrrOf-wWpu0NxcOvG6wnNrWxUBp2pWvfKDJQuLKEciskXUB50dz7epp-QNK4O5lRW4JRHb__rqNnriStFV61xGFgMa-0v3cr14yjduhrlUciR7igDAF9SaZLY-M41tItck4weErSvaE3c997IXnQHRZf-nNs4EzZWkpNLf1VnF?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Deputy**

(Best for shift-based businesses)

- Employee scheduling.
- Time and attendance tracking.
- Timesheets and payroll integrations.
- Useful for hospitality and retail.

[Deputy website](https://www.deputy.com/au)

These recommendations reflect Australian payroll requirements and comparisons published in October–November 2026. [australiansmallbusiness.com.au](https://australiansmallbusiness.com.au/software/best-payroll-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[rankite.com](https://rankite.com/blog/best-payroll-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.techrepublic.com](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/best-payroll-software-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For a typical small Australian business\:

- **Xero** if you want accounting and payroll together.
- **Employment Hero** if you have employees working under different Modern Awards.
- **MYOB** if you just need straightforward payroll for a handful of employees.

One important consideration: from 1 July 2026, Payday Super requirements apply, so make sure your provider supports paying super in line with the new requirements.

search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
